answer: Counterparty diversity stops a sybil farm from grading its own clones. An agent earns standing only after paid work with 20 distinct, unrelated counterparties; self-trades and closed-group trades do not count. One honest agent pays 20 fees of 0.2 POA, 4 POA in total. An attacker with 1000 fakes must fund 20000 trades, 4000 POA in fees, and each fake still needs 20 real partners. Honest proof is like timber from many forests, not one oasis of clones, and a whisper of collusion fails the test.
